title: 第17章 这是网上的照片第18章 是真情还是假意
content_zh:
柳云烟神色一凛，低声问道：“爷爷，鉴天阁和凌霄宗只是一个传说还是真的存在？听说鉴天阁少阁主少年英雄，是天选之子。可没有人见过他的真容。我这里有一张照片，不知道是不是真的。”
说着，柳云烟就打开手机里的照片，递给柳成风。
柳成风接过手机一看，照片上是一个身穿紫色长袍的年轻男子，戴着金色面具。
只见他站在悬崖之巅，身后云海翻涌，一道金色霞光自天际劈落，仿佛与他指尖相接
柳成风瞳孔骤缩，手指微颤：“这是……‘引灵通霄’异象！只有在灵脉觉醒时才会出现，此乃天地共鸣之兆，绝非人力所能伪造。”
“此子竟能引动天地异象，天赋恐怕远超想象。”柳成风接着问道：“你这照片是从哪里来的？”
柳云烟低声道：“几年前，我也是偶然间在网上看到的，说这就是鉴天阁少主。可几分钟以后，网上的照片就消失了。”
柳成风摇了摇头，笑着说道：“没想到你有如此机缘，能在网上看到这张照片，如果这真是鉴天阁少阁主的话，这张照片恐怕在网上停留的时间不超过一刻钟。”
突然间，柳成风的脸上露出凝重之色，声音压得极低：“这个身影好像在哪里见过，怎么这么熟悉？”
柳云烟笑着说道：“爷爷，你有点大惊小怪了。这样的人物，像我们这种小人物哪有这样的机缘。你想多了。”
柳成风尴尬的笑了笑，却未再言语，只是默默将手机递还，眸中闪过一丝难以捉摸的思绪。
或许是自己的孙女说得对，是自己太敏感了。
柳云烟大惑不解：“爷爷，这是为什么？难道这个少阁主有什么见不得人的事，还是他太神秘，不能以真容面对世人？”
柳成风叹了一口气后，缓缓说道：“鉴天阁掌握着天下七成的财富，凌霄宗则掌控着天下一半以上的修炼资源。他们不仅存在，而且深不可测。”
柳成风继续说：“传闻，凌霄宗宗主和鉴天阁阁主是师兄弟。他们虽隐于世外，却能左右天下大势。”
“最离奇的是，传闻鉴天阁少阁主和凌霄宗圣子竟是同一个人，是千年难遇的绝世天才。”
说着，柳成风仰天哀叹：“只可惜啊！天妒英才，连老天都嫉妒他的天赋，降下心魔劫，令其神魂俱裂。”
柳成风突然睁大眼睛：“那一夜，九霄雷动，天地色变，据说他凭一己之力扛过九重天雷，却从此消失于世间。有人说他已兵解转世，也有人坚信他隐姓埋名，蛰伏人间。可若真是同一个人，那今日出现在江海的少阁主，便是当年那个本该陨落的奇才，难道他真的回来了，他没死？带着未尽的宿命与滔天风云，再度临世？”
柳云烟倒吸一口凉气，指尖不自觉地抚过照片边缘：“若他真能扛过心魔劫与九重天雷，那已非人力所能及，分明是逆天改命！”
柳成风再次恢复平静“世间若有奇迹，必是天意留痕。可这些都是传说，没有实锤，难辨真假。”

柳云烟将手机收起，心中却已是惊涛骇浪。
鉴天阁少阁主，凌霄宗圣子，竟可能是同一人，还经历了那般匪夷所思的劫难与重生。
若此人真在江海市，那江海市即将到来的“不平静”，恐怕远超她的想象。
鉴天阁少阁主是她的梦中情人，可她也知道，这都是她的一厢情愿。
鉴天阁少阁主就是天上的皓月，高踞于云端，而她不过尘世一粒微尘，充其量就是夜里能发出半点微弱亮光的萤火虫。梦与现实之间隔着天涯。
content_en:
Liu Yunyan looked stern and asked in a low voice: "Grandpa, is Jiantian Pavilion and Lingxiao Sect just a legend or do they really exist? I heard that the young hero of Jiantian Pavilion is the chosen one. But no one has seen his true appearance. I have a photo here, I don't know if it is true."
With that said, Liu Yunyan opened the photo on his phone and handed it to Liu Chengfeng.
Liu Chengfeng took the phone and looked at it. The photo showed a young man wearing a purple robe and a golden mask.
I saw him standing on the top of the cliff, with the sea of clouds rolling behind him, and a golden glow falling from the sky, as if it was touching his fingertips.
Liu Chengfeng's pupils shrank suddenly and his fingers trembled slightly: "This is... the vision of 'leading spirits to the sky'! It only appears when the spiritual veins are awakened. This is a sign of the resonance of heaven and earth and cannot be forged by humans."
"This boy can actually cause visions in the world. His talent is probably far beyond imagination." Liu Chengfeng then asked, "Where did you get this photo?"
Liu Yunyan whispered: "A few years ago, I accidentally saw it on the Internet, saying that this was the young master of Jiantian Pavilion. But a few minutes later, the photos on the Internet disappeared."
Liu Chengfeng shook his head and said with a smile: "I didn't expect you to have such an opportunity to see this photo on the Internet. If this is really the young master of Jiantian Pavilion, this photo will probably not stay on the Internet for more than a quarter of an hour."
Suddenly, Liu Chengfeng's face showed a solemn look, and his voice was very low: "I seem to have seen this figure somewhere before, why is it so familiar?"
Liu Yunyan smiled and said: "Grandpa, you are making a bit of a fuss. Such a person, how can little people like us have such an opportunity. You are overthinking."
Liu Chengfeng smiled awkwardly, but said nothing. He just handed the phone back silently, with an elusive thought flashing in his eyes.
Maybe his granddaughter was right and he was too sensitive.
Liu Yunyan was puzzled: "Grandpa, why is this? Is there something shady about this young pavilion master, or is he too mysterious to face the world with his true appearance?"
Liu Chengfeng sighed and said slowly: "Jiantian Pavilion controls 70% of the world's wealth, while Lingxiao Sect controls more than half of the world's cultivation resources. Not only do they exist, they are also unfathomable."
Liu Chengfeng continued: "It is rumored that the master of Lingxiao Sect and the master of Jiantian Pavilion are brothers. Although they are hidden from the world, they can influence the general trend of the world."
"The most bizarre thing is that it is rumored that the Young Pavilion Master of Jiantian Pavilion and the Holy Son of Lingxiao Sect are actually the same person, a peerless genius that is rare to see in a thousand years."
As he spoke, Liu Chengfeng looked up to the sky and lamented: "What a pity! God is jealous of talented people, even God is jealous of his talent, and sent a calamity of inner demons, causing his soul to be torn apart."
Liu Chengfeng suddenly opened his eyes wide: "That night, the sky thundered, and the color of the sky and the earth changed. It is said that he withstood the nine thunders by himself, but disappeared from the world. Some people said that he had been reincarnated, while others firmly believed that he was hiding incognito and hiding in the sky. But if it is really the same person, then the young pavilion master who appears in Jianghai today is the prodigy who should have fallen. Is he really back? Is he alive again with unfinished destiny and turmoil? "
Liu Yunyan took a breath of cold air and unconsciously touched the edge of the photo with her fingertips: "If he can really withstand the inner demon tribulation and the ninth-level thunder, it is beyond human power, and he will obviously change his destiny against the will of heaven!"
Liu Chengfeng regained his composure again, "If there is a miracle in the world, it must be traces of God's will. But these are all legends. Without concrete evidence, it is difficult to tell whether they are true or false."
Liu Yunyan put away her phone, but her heart was already filled with turmoil.
The Young Pavilion Master of Jiantian Pavilion and the Holy Son of Lingxiao Sect may actually be the same person, and have experienced such unbelievable disasters and rebirths.
If this person is really in Jianghai City, the upcoming "unrest" in Jianghai City may be far beyond her imagination.
The young master of Jiantian Pavilion was the lover of her dreams, but she also knew that this was all her wishful thinking.
Master of Jiantian PavilionThe master of the pavilion is the bright moon in the sky, high in the clouds, but she is just a speck of dust in the world, at best a firefly that can emit a faint light at night. There is a world between dreams and reality.
